title: Model Compatibility Gatekeeper: procurement & competitive detection runbook
creator: Ava Nguyen
description:
Purpose: build a lightweight 'Gatekeeper' runbook and tooling checklist that product, procurement, and DS teams can use to quickly assess whether a new model (internal or third-party) is operationally compatible with Redwood serving and to flag competitive risk signals.

Scope: this ticket covers definition of signal heuristics, a decision matrix, instrumentation requirements (telemetry keys and thresholds), and a starter PRD + intake form. We will not build full automation for model substitution in this sprint — the focus is on repeatable human + checklist workflows and telemetry to enable follow-up automation.

Deliverables:
- Compatibility decision matrix (API surface, tokenization, KV/cache shape, quantization/formatability, latency envelope)
- Telemetry spec (fields to capture on requests & model variant responses; anomaly thresholds for cost/latency/behavioral deltas)
- Intake checklist for procurement/PMs + templated Confluence intake page and Google Sheet tracker
- Runbook for competitive detection signals (sudden delta in latency/cost per token, small-but-consistent output drift vs baseline, API contract deviations)
- Stakeholder sign-off checklist and pilot plan with 2 field teams

Success criteria (measurable):
- Checklist used for at least 3 model onboarding requests during pilot window
- Telemetry capturing the defined signal set in staging for 7 days with at least one alert simulated
- Time-to-decision reduced by >= 30% vs current ad-hoc process

Constraints & trade-offs:
- Trade-off between strict compatibility gates (fast block) and business agility — runbook should allow configurable "guardrail" levels (strict, standard, experimental).
- We will prioritize telemetry fields that are cheap to emit from runtime (latency, token counts, model name/variant, quantization tag, response shape hash) and defer heavy semantic evals to later tickets.

Primary stakeholders: PM (Ava Nguyen), Procurement (Leila Kapoor), Applied ML (Dr. Samir Patel), Runtime Eng (Diego Morales), SRE (Tanya Chen).
